text:
emma: quick dry-run check — curation sprint 7 smoke test tomorrow 10am PT. need final owners for these models: orion-3b, ember-7b, tide-1.2b. licensing + perf profiles must be cleared today. cc @sanjay @lina :eyes:

sanjay: I can own orchestration + perf for orion & ember. tide needs a quantization profile and a smaller KV-cache test. who owns quant bits?

lina: legal quick note — orion-3b has an MPL component in one submodule, need confirmation it's allowed in our catalog. ember-7b looks fine (Apache-2.0). tide-1.2b we need CLA from upstream maintainer.

mark: runtime heads-up: ember-7b's max-seq is 4096 by default — plan to enforce a 2048 SLO for hosted to hit latency targets. that'll need a model variant in catalog (ember-7b@2048). also quantized path for tide will require kernel selection tweaks.

cassie: canary scheduling: I have a 2-hour slot tomorrow 17:00-19:00 UTC that works. will run traffic ramp 5% -> 25% -> 50%. need final model shards and inference config before 16:00 UTC.

emma: action items:
- lina: confirm orion MPL allowance or block (EOD)
- sanjay: perf numbers + eval set link (EOD)
- mark: prepare ember@2048 variant + tide quant baseline (by 15:30 UTC)
- cassie: canary runbook + rollbackhooks (draft by 16:00)

sanjay: evals are in gs://redwood-models/curation/sprint7/evals — run `./eval/run_perf.sh --model orion-3b --batch 8` for baseline. small snippet:```bash
./eval/run_perf.sh --model ember-7b --seq 2048 --warmup 100
```

lina: flagged orion with licensing team. quick ask: does anyone have the exact submodule URL? send it here and I'll escalate.

mark: pushed ember@2048 manifest to staging catalog: `catalog://staging/ember-7b@2048` — note the runtime flag `--force-shorter-seq`. tide quant baseline: `quant=8bit_gptq` (draft).

deployment-bot: scheduled canary: catalog://staging/ember-7b@2048 -> prod canary at 4365002277 (2026-03-19T17:00:00Z) by cassie

cassie: greenlight on schedule if legal/quant are cleared by 16:00. i'll post the runbook and the rollout script in #eng-ml after 15:45.

emma: if we hit any blocker call out here asap. otherwise we'll treat missing tide quant as a soft-fail (skip tide) and proceed with orion+ember smoke. thanks all :thumbsup:
